summary.text:
Benton MacKaye National Scenic Trail Feasibility Study Act of 2025
This bill requires the Forest Service to study the feasibility of designating the Benton MacKaye Trail as a national scenic trail. The trail traverses approximately 287 miles in Georgia, Tennessee, and North Carolina.

title: Benton MacKaye National Scenic Trail Feasibility Study Act of 2025
